title: everyday parts, an eighth round: a cam, a boss up to a tilted plane, a 270° ring, a drafted tray, a shaft collar, a swept handle, holes in a slanted face

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a cam: circles of radius 15 at the origin and 8 at (30, 0) joined by two lines held tangent to both, extruded 6, bores of radius 5 and 3

cases.name: c002
cases.description: a 40 × 20 × 5 plate with a boss (radius 5) at its middle extruded up to a plane through (20, 10, 25) tilted 11.3° about y

cases.name: c003
cases.description: a ring (radii 10 to 20, 8 tall) revolved 270° about z, its start cap's outer edge filleted 2

cases.name: c004
cases.description: a tray: a 60 × 40 × 15 block with a 50 × 30 pocket 10 deep cut with a 5° draft, its floor's edges filleted 2

cases.name: c005
cases.description: a shaft collar: a ring (radii 8 to 15, 10 tall) split by a slot 2 wide on its +x side, a clamp hole (radius 1.5) across the slot at x = 11.5, half way up

cases.name: c006
cases.description: a handle: a circle (radius 3) swept up 20, round an arc (radius 5), along 30, round another and down 20

cases.name: c007
cases.description: a wedge (sloping from 20 tall to 10 over 40, 20 deep) with two holes (diameter 5, 10 deep) drilled square to its slanted face
